title: Why are all LLMs Obsessed with Japanese Culture? On the Hidden Cultural and Regional Biases of LLMs
reasoning: The paper develops the CROQ benchmark which includes a specific 'Beliefs, Values, and Identity' domain. Within this domain, the taxonomy evaluates Large Language Models on subtopics such as 'Religion & Spirituality' (including beliefs about the divine and morality) and 'Values & Ethics' (core beliefs about right/wrong).
